name: Tezzeret
aliases: the man with the metal arm
the planeswalker with the metal arm
description: A devious inventor and planeswalker who manipulates metal to create complex devices and deadly mechanical servants.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls that she and Jace once worked for Tezzeret's Consortium (backstory).
timeline.quote: when she and Jace had worked for Tezzeret's criminal Consortium

timeline.summary: A gray-haired hooded man sneaks through Ghirapur toward the Inventors' Fair, avoiding patrols.
timeline.quote: A gray-haired man slipped through Ghirapur with a series of sideways moves.

timeline.summary: The hooded man hides his face and arm in the crowd to complete his mission unnoticed.
timeline.quote: He needed to complete his mission before anyone had a chance to notice him.

timeline.summary: The hooded man shows a Leaking Spire symbol to renegade inventors and steals a listener module from an automaton.
timeline.quote: The little metallic listener module obeyed his commands, prying itself out of her device.

timeline.summary: The module reveals to the man the conversations and a location for the demonstration.
timeline.quote: As he walked, he willed it to activate

timeline.summary: Chandra calls to the hooded man, who runs away through the crowd.
timeline.quote: he dashed away from them, through a bank of onlookers and around a Consulate checkpoint.

timeline.summary: The man accosts an older woman, pointing a metallic claw hand at her.
timeline.quote: His right hand, emerging from his sleeve, was a metallic claw

timeline.summary: Tezzeret calls the woman Renegade Prime and warns her spectacle will not matter to his Fair, but she vows to stop the Head Judge.
timeline.quote: I've found you at last, Renegade Prime

timeline.summary: Liliana grabs the man and names him Tezzeret with disgust.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret, flanked by automatons and Dovin Baan, seizes Pia with his metal claw.
timeline.quote: The hand that gripped her arm was a massive claw of dark metal

timeline.summary: Tezzeret calls Pia the Renegade Prime and she vows to stop him.
timeline.quote: I've found you at last, Renegade Prime

timeline.summary: Liliana appears and names Tezzeret, and he names her Vess in return.
timeline.quote: A pale woman clad in dark flowing silks and a glinting golden headpiece appeared opposite the Head Judge.

timeline.summary: To protect Chandra, Pia announces herself as the renegade leader and surrenders to Consulate custody.
timeline.quote: My name is Pia Nalaar, leader of the renegades. I'm prepared to enter Consulate custody.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls Jace's scars when she thinks of Tezzeret and warns he is dangerous.
timeline.quote: Jace, his back stitched with ugly white scars from a manablade.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Nashi overhears Tamiyo tell Ajani that Nashi's village was burned by planeswalkers at the behest of the criminal Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: It was at the behest of a planeswalking criminal named Tezzeret.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo says Tezzeret died three years ago, killed by Nashi's villagers and betrayed by comrades.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret died...three years ago, I think?

timeline.summary: In a flashback five months ago Ajani tells Nashi he is leaving Kamigawa to find the man who killed Nashi's family.
timeline.quote: To find the man who killed your family.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Nissa he has followed Tezzeret's movements on Kaladesh for weeks.
timeline.quote: We've been following Tezzeret's movements here for weeks.

timeline.summary: Banners across the city advertise a showdown between Head Judge Tezzeret and the renegade criminal Pia Nalaar the next noon.
timeline.quote: INVENTORS! COME WITNESS THE SHOWDOWN OF THE CENTURY.

timeline.summary: The duel starts with Pia and Tezzeret each given a container of basic parts.
timeline.quote: Let the showdown...begin!

timeline.summary: Pia's booby-trapped servo destroys the legs of Tezzeret's crawler.
timeline.quote: The servo burst in a small sphere of smoke and pieces, and blew the legs off the crawler.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret's devices devour her parts, kill her thopter and he summons an army of automatons around her.
timeline.quote: Bands of metal curved unnaturally at his will, coiling in on themselves to become a small squad of other sharp-legged automatons.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret declares he will mete out justice and sets his automaton to kill Pia.
timeline.quote: I will mete out proper justice for yours.

timeline.summary: A bolt of fire from the audience fells the attacking automaton; Chandra has intervened.
timeline.quote: The bolt of fire had streaked out of the audience

timeline.summary: Chandra leaps into the arena, refusing her mother's order to leave and declaring she will not lose her again.
timeline.quote: And I'm not losing you again!

timeline.summary: Illusions behind Chandra dissolve to reveal the Gatewatch, and Tezzeret takes a small step backward.
timeline.quote: A host of illusions dissolved behind Chandra, and one by one, a team of Planeswalkers emerged.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers battle Tezzeret's automatons while Ajani and Gideon protect Pia.
timeline.quote: Fire flew, slamming like fists into Tezzeret's machines, felling one after another.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that Tezzeret's blocked mind means he was prepared and they have made a mistake.
timeline.quote: if he knew to block his mind, it means he was prepared for this.

timeline.summary: Chandra compresses a blinding point of fire to kill Tezzeret as Liliana urges her on.
timeline.quote: Chandra's fist closed, compressing fire into a tiny point of blinding, seething heat.

timeline.summary: The Skysovereign eclipses the arena with its turret ready to fire.
timeline.quote: A stark shadow passed over the arena

timeline.summary: Tezzeret announces the end of the Inventors' Fair and rises into the airship, retreating.
timeline.quote: And this concludes the Inventors' Fair, everyone.

timeline.summary: Pia says Tezzeret's duel was a distraction and Ajani says he is building something.
timeline.quote: He's building something

timeline.summary: Baan touches Tezzeret's arm and realizes the metal claw is a replacement limb he had not noticed before.
timeline.quote: he realized it was part of the arm

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says the Gatewatch interrupted his duel and disappeared with the renegade.
timeline.quote: I was referring specifically to the gang of six Planeswalkers who interrupted that duel and disappeared with the renegade.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret claims the confiscations are safeguarding the inventions from renegade attack.
timeline.quote: It's not as though we're stealing their inventions. We're safeguarding them.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret snarls that there is no time, then sheds his rage, which Baan notices.
timeline.quote: There's no time

timeline.summary: Tezzeret offers Baan the job of leading Consulate exploration of the confiscated inventions.
timeline.quote: And who better than you to lead that effort?

timeline.summary: Baan explains he invited some Gatewatch planeswalkers as a safeguard, but they refused and only Nissa came.
timeline.quote: I invited some of them here as a safeguard against a potential fault I identified in the plans for the Inventors' Fair

timeline.summary: Tezzeret orders Baan to fix the situation, secure an inquirium for himself and keep the Bastion on alert.
timeline.quote: You need to fix this, Baan.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reveals that Rashmi's work has staggering implications larger than Kaladesh and will be his focus.
timeline.quote: Rashmi's work for the fair had staggering implications.

timeline.summary: Head Judge Tezzeret calls for theoretical breakthroughs in the Aether Science category.
timeline.quote: Head Judge Tezzeret himself has put out the call for any and all theoretical breakthroughs

timeline.summary: The cloaked figure is revealed as Tezzeret, who was stalking Pia Nalaar; Chandra and Pia, each thinking the other dead, are shocked, and the Consulate takes Pia prisoner.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret, Dovin, and Consulate enforcers take Pia prisoner, accusing her of leading the renegade threat.

timeline.summary: At the Grand Exhibition Chandra runs into the arena and the Gatewatch support her against Tezzeret, who slips away; Pia is safe.
timeline.quote: Just when they think they have Tezzeret cornered, he slips away.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch realize the showdown was Tezzeret's scheme: the Consulate confiscated all the Fair's inventions and Tezzeret locks himself away to build a device.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret's accomplices in the Consulate confiscated all the wondrous inventions at the Fair.

timeline.summary: Gideon weighs, over coffee, whether the Gatewatch should be taking sides in Kaladesh's local conflict.
timeline.quote: should the Gatewatch be taking sides in this local conflict ?

timeline.summary: Chandra agrees to focus on stopping Tezzeret, while also helping her mother as Pia Nalaar's daughter.
timeline.quote: And, as much as I hate it, I'll try to focus on stopping Tezzeret....for now.

timeline.summary: Liliana says there is just one person she wants to kill on this plane and tells Gideon Tezzeret destroyed something that was hers.
timeline.quote: "He hurt something important to me. Destroyed something that was mine."

timeline.summary: Saheeli reveals she has found where Tezzeret is hiding, in a private workshop in the central Aether Spire, where he holds the winning inventor.
timeline.quote: He has locked himself away in a private workshop, hidden in the central Aether Spire.

timeline.summary: Rashmi notices that aerowright Sana's workstation was emptied after Tezzeret's first progress check.
timeline.quote: The sight of aerowright Sana's empty workstation dissolved any spirit of comradery

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives for a progress check and bends Bhavin's automaton's arm, then throws Bhavin out and takes his invention.
timeline.quote: "You've failed. Get out."

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells the inventors that anything made in the Inquirium belongs to the Consulate.
timeline.quote: "Anything made in this Inquirium belongs to the Consulate."

timeline.summary: Rashmi presents the scaled-up transporter and works out the answer to Tezzeret's nonlinear-transport question.
timeline.quote: If I insert an attenuator into the aether-loop

timeline.summary: Tezzeret has a functionary dismissed for objecting to rerouting aether and threatens to terminate Rashmi if she cannot move Bhavin's automaton by the next check.
timeline.quote: "If you don't, you will be terminated."

timeline.summary: Rashmi tells Tezzeret of the phantom dimensions; he laughs at her, declares the transporter his, and dismisses her.
timeline.quote: "This beautiful creation is now mine. And thus I am done with you."

timeline.summary: Tezzeret threatens to kill Rashmi and then bring Mitul to complete the transporter and kill him too, and sends functionaries to fetch Mitul.
timeline.quote: I will bring your little friend—Mitul, I believe was his name—to complete the transporter

timeline.summary: Rashmi secretly sends a warning note to Mitul through the old transporter ring while distracting Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: dropping the ball of paper through the ring. It disappeared.

timeline.summary: Rashmi rigs the transporter so the demonstration backfires; Tezzeret's test sends the automaton onto a box, crushing the desk and shattering the window.
timeline.quote: Too big to fit, Bhavin's masterpiece crushed the box

timeline.summary: Rashmi leaps out of the window on a harness cable and escapes Tezzeret above Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: she sprinted to the gaping hole and leapt out into the swirling aether beyond.

timeline.summary: Consul Kambal demands Sram carry out Tezzeret's order to divert the city's aether to the Spire; Sram demands it in writing.
timeline.quote: "You have your orders, Senior Edificer," said Kambal.

timeline.summary: Liliana convinces a reluctant Gideon that she must go alone and unarmed to duel and distract Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: I have to go alone, unarmed, or else your whole plan falls apart.

timeline.summary: Liliana arrives in the war-torn streets of Ghirapur, recalling Caligo Forest, resolved to kill Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret had to die.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls working for Bolas and turning Jace against Tezzeret, and Jace wrecking Tezzeret's mind on Ravnica four years ago.
timeline.quote: Jace had wrecked Tezzeret's mind and left him for dead on some remote plane.

timeline.summary: Liliana notes the vortex of energy around the Spire and guesses Tezzeret has activated the portal.
timeline.quote: Liliana guessed that Tezzeret had activated that portal.

timeline.summary: Liliana attacks Tezzeret in the portal chamber; a scrap construct shields him.
timeline.quote: a hulk of sharp-edged metal detached itself from the heaps of junk around the edges of the room

timeline.summary: Tezzeret claims credit for Rashmi's invention and taunts Liliana about Jace and the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: She would have been sending vases across Ghirapur forever if I hadn't guided her tiny little mind.

timeline.summary: Liliana drains Tezzeret's life using the Chain Veil and her zombie attacks him.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret clutched at his throat and fell to his knees

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes Tezzeret is working for Bolas to pay a debt.
timeline.quote: "Oh," Liliana breathed. "Oh. You're here for Bolas."

timeline.summary: Liliana pins Tezzeret under her heel and forces him to reveal Bolas is on Amonkhet, home of the demon Razaketh.
timeline.quote: "Razaketh," he gasped.

timeline.summary: The oversized thopter bursts toward the Spire with Chandra's red hair visible at its tip.
timeline.quote: she caught a glimpse as she ducked behind the wall, of flaming red hair at the tip of the oversized thopter.

timeline.summary: The explosion destroys Tezzeret's gate and buries Liliana in rubble; Tezzeret's fate is unknown.
timeline.quote: A huge column of smoke boiled up from where Tezzeret's gate had stood.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Chandra and Gideon alive; Tezzeret is either buried or has fled to his master.
timeline.quote: "He's either buried in this rubble or run home to his master."

timeline.summary: On Skysovereign, Tezzeret screams at an orderly and Baan challenges the Grand Consul's tactics privately.
timeline.quote: I acknowledge the effectiveness of your harangues at keeping this crew aligned and attentive. I, however, am...unimpressed.

timeline.summary: Baan lays out a pincer-and-airborne plan to retake the Aether Hub, exploiting the Gatewatch's divided leadership and Chandra's rashness.
timeline.quote: Transports loaded with Inspectors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret orders Baral to lure the Nalaars and their friends away from the Hub, adding Baan to Baral's squad.
timeline.quote: Annoy the Nalaars. Lure them away from the Aether Hub.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives late, and Bolas sends him to fetch Ral Zarek, saying the battle was better than blood.
timeline.quote: Go and tell Ral Zarek to come to me.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes Vraska is meant to call Tezzeret to retrieve the Immortal Sun through the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: It's Tezzeret. He's the one you're meant to call.

timeline.summary: Tameshi dies after whispering the name Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: "Tezzeret," Tameshi whispered like he was breaking a spell. And then he was gone.

timeline.summary: A Living Historian's account reveals a nezumi village was burned five years earlier on Tezzeret's order, and the child Nashi survived.
timeline.quote: Nashi listened to the adults whisper the name of the man who ordered the attack.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells Kaito that Tezzeret is the man with the metal arm and that he burned the nezumi village.
timeline.quote: Kaito learned that Tezzeret wasn't just a planeswalker—he was the planeswalker with the metal arm.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret appears and tells them the experiments are about testing the connection between body and soul for Phyrexia, thanking them for bringing planeswalkers to the lab.
timeline.quote: And kami are much easier to come by than what Phyrexia really needs."

timeline.summary: Tezzeret restrains Tamiyo with the lab's equipment and holds star-blades to Kaito's throat.
timeline.quote: a strip of metal equipment tore from the ceiling and wrapped itself around her hand like a monstrous restraint.

timeline.summary: Kaito throws a detonator at the machine room, but Tezzeret catches it and breaks it apart; Kaito is knocked unconscious.
timeline.quote: the detonator broke apart piece by piece, until it became nothing more than a pile of useless metal and microchips.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer, Kaito and Tamiyo defeat the henchmen in the compound and hold Tezzeret paralyzed; the Wanderer decides to bring him to Kyodai.
timeline.quote: "Yes. We will decide his fate together."

timeline.summary: Tezzeret takes control of the Reality Chip on the Wanderer's hand, destabilizing her spark and linking her to Kyodai in agony.
timeline.quote: no time to shout a warning before Tezzeret took control of the Reality Chip.

timeline.summary: Kaito knocks Tezzeret out with two crates.
timeline.quote: The impact knocked Tezzeret out cold.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer disables a surveillance mech and the group flies to Eiganjo on its back, carrying Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The mech let out a ragged groan before lowering its body to the ground

timeline.summary: Tezzeret wakes and flings Kaito's smoke devices, then jumps from the mech; Tamiyo loses control and the group jumps before the mech crashes.
timeline.quote: the mech exploding against the side of an Imperial apartment.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo track Tezzeret as he heads for the emperor and fight him on the rooftops, with Eiko's dagger striking him.
timeline.quote: In his thigh was a gleaming dagger, the gold handle carved with the symbol of the Imperials.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret takes control of the chip on Tamiyo's hand, opens a portal and drags her away.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret yanked Tamiyo through the snapping light, and they both vanished from the rooftop.

timeline.summary: In the Phyrexian laboratory Tamiyo awakens Phyrexianized, loyal to Phyrexia and calling it her new family.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia was her new home.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias announces the first Phyrexianized planeswalker and Tezzeret asks whether Elesh Norn knows.
timeline.quote: Does Elesh Norn know you've succeeded in creating the first Phyrexianized planeswalker?"

timeline.summary: Vivien recognizes a stranger as a planeswalker, who leads her out of the hall.
timeline.quote: He was also a planeswalker.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien that others like them are present and that his employer is acquiring Halo with other goals, and invites her to meet Urabrask.
timeline.quote: "Good, come along then. Urabrask will be eager to meet you."

timeline.summary: Vivien confronts Tezzeret, recalling that they fought on opposite sides in the War of the Spark, and refuses his orders.
timeline.quote: They'd fought on opposite sides during the War of the Spark

timeline.summary: Vivien follows Tezzeret down through the girders beneath New Capenna, wary of him but trusting her gut.
timeline.quote: Vivien trusted her gut and followed him deeper into the underbelly of this strange, new plane.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reveals the glowing Planar Bridge in his chest as a show of trust, and admits it corrupted after carrying the praetors.
timeline.quote: "A show of trust and good faith."

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien he works for Elesh Norn, and Vivien draws her bow on him in hostility.
timeline.quote: The bowstring was at her cheek in a breath, her opposite arm outstretched.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret admits he is playing both sides: he needs what Norn promised but does not want life destroyed or himself transformed, and Vivien relaxes.
timeline.quote: He was playing both sides.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret leads Vivien to a wounded Phyrexian, Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, in a cavern below the city.
timeline.quote: "Vivien, meet Urabrask," Tezzeret said.

timeline.summary: Urabrask accuses Tezzeret of betraying him, and Tezzeret says he has brought a new ally.
timeline.quote: "You betrayed me," Urabrask hissed to Tezzeret.

timeline.summary: Vivien agrees to fetch Halo for the recovering Urabrask in exchange for his plan to bring Norn down, and learns the Planar Bridge wounded him.
timeline.quote: "You have a deal."

timeline.summary: Vivien names Tezzeret as the intermediary who arranged her audience, and Kaya objects strongly.
timeline.quote: You know what he did on Ravnica!

timeline.summary: Karn lies bound on a slab as Suture Bishops dissect him, offering no resistance, while Tezzeret watches.
timeline.quote: But Karn gave no resistance to the team of aspirants as they bound him into place

timeline.summary: Ajani, compleated, quotes Elesh Norn's scripture over Karn as the priests dismantle him.
timeline.quote: Only in her grace are we saved,

timeline.summary: An angel blocks Tezzeret from leaving and orders him to carry the pieces of Karn to Elesh Norn for his reward.
timeline.quote: you will bring the pieces of Father to our Mother.

timeline.summary: Ajani gives Tezzeret his cloak, once worn by Elspeth, and Tezzeret suspects the true Ajani remains suppressed within.
timeline.quote: it was the same cloak once worn by Elspeth Tirel.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret feigns obedience and sets out through the Fair Basilica toward the core pushing Karn's pieces.
timeline.quote: As our Mother wishes,

timeline.summary: Tezzeret suspects a trap, kills the Phyrexian guide with a thrust and heads into the Mycosynth alone.
timeline.quote: with a single well-placed thrust, ran it through.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reaches Memnarch's restored darksteel Panopticon and cannot open its door.
timeline.quote: darksteel, as a matter of fact

timeline.summary: Karn speaks, explaining he is tethered to the plane and offering to open the tower, since it was once his realm.
timeline.quote: I can take you inside. This was my realm once, after all.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret detaches Karn's head and Karn uses it to open the darksteel door.
timeline.quote: Karn's efforts caused the door to slide open.

timeline.summary: In the Darksteel Eye, Tezzeret sees vast Phyrexian legions assembling but cannot view Urabrask's domain or Elesh Norn's sanctum.
timeline.quote: he discovered that two locations managed to defy the eye's intrusion.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret and Karn argue over Karn's responsibility for New Phyrexia and Bolas's threat, and Tezzeret reveals he suggested eliminating the plane to Bolas.
timeline.quote: His first act as god-emperor would have been to obliterate New Phyrexia from existence.

timeline.summary: Karn admits he hears the same oil voices as Tezzeret, and Tezzeret threatens him but relents, fearing compleation.
timeline.quote: The same voices I heard when the oil had command of my heart.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reaches Elesh Norn at the heart of the plane, where she takes Karn's torso and welcomes him to the great work.
timeline.quote: We welcome you to our great work.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn tells Tezzeret he will be herald on Dominaria; he realizes she will not give him his body and resolves to wage war on her.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn had no intention of fulfilling her promise.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn dismisses Tezzeret, who leaves angrily.
timeline.quote: With a growl, Tezzeret turned and walked away.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret enters Shiv's cave complex and brutally forces Rona to give a status report.
timeline.quote: I've been told that unprotected flesh takes a few seconds to vaporize in the Blind Eternities.

timeline.summary: Rona reports the Phyrexians' losses and that the Planeswalkers have been tracked to New Argive.
timeline.quote: But we have been able to track them back to New Argive.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives, spares Elspeth, tells her to disappear before the tower falls, and carries off Rona.
timeline.quote: I suggest you take this opportunity to find somewhere remote and disappear.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives at the Fair Basilica through the Planar Bridge carrying Rona's remains and demands to see Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: I must see Mother,

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn summons Tezzeret and orders Rona's remains sent to Jin-Gitaxias.
timeline.quote: Send the other to Jin-Gitaxias for reconditioning.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret blames his failure on Rona and Sheoldred's treachery, and Norn accepts it.
timeline.quote: We were routed when our own troops turned on us.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn questions Tezzeret's love for her, while Tezzeret restrains his urge to kill her.
timeline.quote: One well-placed thrust of his sharpened arm could impale her head or take it right off.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Norn that the Planeswalkers' new leader is Elspeth Tirel, wielding a blade of white light, and Norn grows fearful.
timeline.quote: The leader's name is Elspeth Tirel.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret asks for his promised darksteel body and collapses, and Norn declares a promise is a promise.
timeline.quote: A promise is a promise.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret wakes bound in Jin-Gitaxias's laboratory, where Tamiyo was compleated.
timeline.quote: So it was happening. His reward, finally here.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias melts Tezzeret's etherium arm to bond his spine to the darksteel body.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret watched as the embodiment of his own exceptionalism melted into slag.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret's head and spine are transferred into the darksteel body and he has a vision of a clock and an island of metal.
timeline.quote: Then his head and spine were separated from his body

timeline.summary: Tezzeret awakens in his new body but cannot planeswalk because the slab is inlaid with silver.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret had fallen into the same trap.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias reveals a new Reality Chip and says he knows of Urabrask and the Mirran attacks and will let them unfold.
timeline.quote: There is no violating an agreement already broken.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret uses a telemin bond to take control of a captive scrapchief in a tank.
timeline.quote: Give me control , Phyrexian , thought Tezzeret.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret smashes the tank and the slab through the scrapchief, but Jin-Gitaxias kills it, so Tezzeret planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret planeswalked away.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives in Tidehollow, the slum where he grew up, and laughs.
timeline.quote: For Tezzeret, there was only one word associated with Tidehollow that truly resonated.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret drives off a gang of children by animating a knife into its owner's hand, leaving the boy Estel behind.
timeline.quote: he turned, stood, and cast a spell to animate the knife in the leader's hand

timeline.summary: Tezzeret retrieves his mother's box of etherium from the ruins of his childhood home.
timeline.quote: This was his mother's handiwork, the last remnant of the hobby that gave her solace amid the squalor.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians break through the cave ceiling, invading Tidehollow.
timeline.quote: Bone-white metal. The Phyrexians had arrived.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret sends Estel with the box and an enchanted knife to Bant, telling him to say an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent him.
timeline.quote: When you see Rafiq, tell him that an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent you.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret leaves for the Blind Eternities in his father's cloak as Tidehollow is slaughtered.
timeline.quote: A fitting goodbye

timeline.summary: Tezzeret travels across planes already overrun by Phyrexians, finding Baltrice's safehouses compromised.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn's "great work" was unfolding faster than Tezzeret could have imagined.

timeline.summary: Nashi shoots Tezzeret in Towashi's undercity and demands to know where Tamiyo is.
timeline.quote: Tell me where she is.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret turns on Nashi's gang and crushes their motorbikes.
timeline.quote: lifting the bikes into the air and then slamming them together with a gruesome crunch

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells the wounded Nashi that his mother still lives and will come for him.
timeline.quote: Your mother still lives.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret finds Baltrice's safehouse behind a gaming parlor and gathers supplies.
timeline.quote: Inside, he found exactly what he was looking for.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret travels to the ruins of his tower and resolves to wait for the winner of the war to weaken before making his move.
timeline.quote: Then—and only then—would he make his move.

timeline.summary: Nine years earlier, young Jace is sent by Tezzeret to the Fomori vault and senses a childlike mind within.
timeline.quote: he feels a mind deep within the vault, sleepy with torpor, childlike and quiet.

timeline.summary: Sami announces over the intercom that the Metalman has arrived and prefers the name Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The Metalman's here. Come out and present yourselves, or he'll present you.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret enters the Seriema from his black engineless ship.
timeline.quote: He pushes into the Seriema with the calm of a prybar.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret questions Haliya about her armor.
timeline.quote: "You wear a wealth of metal," he says.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret is delighted that Alpharael fled his creed to live.
timeline.quote: I wanted to live a little longer.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret studies Tannuk, remarking on Llanowar and the power he is afraid of.
timeline.quote: So far from Llanowar … such power in the form.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret greets Sami as the protector of strays and asks for his prize.
timeline.quote: Sami, the generous. Sami, the charitable. Sami, the protector of strays.

timeline.summary: Sami tells Tezzeret the stone changes the past, as with the vanished miners of Sigma.
timeline.quote: Change the past to suit its purposes.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret laughs at Haliya's objection to counterfeit memories.
timeline.quote: Listen to her! Counterfeit memories, an atrocity.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says he will see the stone now.
timeline.quote: You're keeping it in your hold. I'll see it now.

timeline.summary: Haliya says she cannot let Tezzeret take the object.
timeline.quote: "I can't let you take the object," Haliya says.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says he arranged events so the stone would choose him as its conduit.
timeline.quote: I have arranged all this so it will choose me as its conduit.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret calls the stone the Endstone, as Alpharael's people name it.
timeline.quote: It's what your people call it. Isn't it, boy? The stone from the end.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret declares he will never serve again and wants nothing from the Endstone.
timeline.quote: I won't flee to a better world. I'll stand and face whoever would rule me.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says the Endstone was made and buried and he will follow it to its maker.
timeline.quote: I must know who made it.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret explains he has made himself the shortest path to ground for the Endstone, like lightning.
timeline.quote: I have made myself the shortest path for the Endstone to reach its maker.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret silently forces Haliya's armor to close on her.
timeline.quote: her armor ripples like porridge and closes on her.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret releases Haliya, who drifts limp, and moves to consult the Endstone.
timeline.quote: Haliya drifts away spinning, limbs limp.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret drops a crystal over a map of Sothera and it rolls to a libratory point near Uthros.
timeline.quote: He pinches it between two of his claw-fingers, lifts it above the map, and lets go.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reads the crystal's result as Uthros and says he will alert Mm'menon.
timeline.quote: Uthros. The stone wants to go to Uthros.

timeline.summary: An Illvoi ship arrives beside the Seriema.
timeline.quote: A ship appears beside them.

timeline.summary: Mm'menon introduces themself and asks to come aboard.
timeline.quote: I am Mm'menon. May I come aboard your home?

timeline.summary: Tezzeret plans to sell the Endstone to its maker, using Mm'menon's ship to boost the Seriema to Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: We will take the Endstone there, and I will sell it to its maker in exchange for a glimpse of their power.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says he will not be changed by any hand but his own.
timeline.quote: I will not be changed by any hand except my own.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret assigns Mm'menon to provide stealthy speed.
timeline.quote: Your role, Mm'menon, is to provide us with stealthy speed.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret admits he is saving his own ship in case he must abandon the others.
timeline.quote: You're saving it in case you need to abandon the rest of us to die.

timeline.summary: Sami threatens to blow up the ship rather than let Tezzeret harm Haliya, invoking mallowmass.
timeline.quote: "I will detonate this ship if I have to," Sami says.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Sami nothing is sacred, only useful, and challenges Sami to prove guest right is useful.
timeline.quote: Nothing's sacred. Only useful.

timeline.summary: A narrator describes alternate branches for where the crystal might point, rejects each, and says to go back and choose better.
timeline.quote: Go back and make a better choice.

timeline.summary: The gravkill paladin collapses into a crumpled ball of alabile, apparently killed by Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The gravkill paladin collapses into a crumpled ball, like crushed foil.

timeline.summary: Alpharael drops the crystal on the map and it settles at the edge of the rag and the system.
timeline.quote: It bounces twice and settles on the very edge of the reading rag, and the solar system, too.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says they will warp until the stone says it has reached its goal.
timeline.quote: We will see what god or monster made this thing.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret toasts the success of taking a piece of the unknown.
timeline.quote: We have taken a piece of the unknown.

timeline.summary: The Endstone changes into a black ovoid and points at Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The stone has lost its glistening facets. It is now a gleamingly black ovoid.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret explains he sent the most disposable of his workers to Sigma so the stone could choose them.
timeline.quote: I chose the most desperate, disposable pawns in my employ.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says they are heading to the place that killed the Wurm Speaker.
timeline.quote: They are saying we are going to the place that killed it.

timeline.summary: A beautiful creature steps out of a split in the cosmos into the galley.
timeline.quote: A beautiful, beautiful creature steps through.

timeline.summary: The visitor declares itself the last thing.
timeline.quote: "I am the last thing," the beautiful android says.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret keeps the severed fingers, inhales their violet light and remarks that Sami has something like a Planeswalker.
timeline.quote: So. You do have something like a Planeswalker.

timeline.summary: Following the Phyrexian invasion, Tezzeret was ejected from the Blind Eternities into the Edge by unknown means.
timeline.quote: He was ejected from the Blind Eternities by methods still unknown.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret works to found a criminal consortium in the Edge.
timeline.quote: all while aiming to lay the foundations of a criminal consortium.

timeline.summary: Mm'menon, expelled from the Uthros Combine, lent services to Tezzeret to stay in-system.
timeline.quote: After being expelled from the Combine, Mm'menon lent their services to Tezzeret to stay in-system

timeline.summary: After years serving more powerful masters, Tezzeret has slowly accumulated power and influence, biding his time to emerge from the shadows.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret has slowly but surely accumulated power and influence

relations.note: He hunts and arrests the Renegade Prime.

relations.quote: just know that I'm here for Tezzeret.

relations.note: She plans to duel and kill him.
relations.quote: I believe having your flesh scoured from your skeleton can be a very effective distraction.

relations.note: Tezzeret works to pay off a debt to Bolas.
relations.quote: I'm working to pay off a debt.

relations.note: She tries to kill him.
relations.quote: Tezzeret had to die.

relations.note: Jace wrecked Tezzeret's mind.
relations.quote: Jace had wrecked Tezzeret's mind and left him for dead on some remote plane.

relations.note: He builds the gate from Rashmi's invention.
relations.quote: "Did they come to see my magnificent gate?"

relations.note: Baral is called in and ordered as Tezzeret's attack dog.
relations.quote: "Baral's an attack dog," Tezzeret said

relations.note: Baan reports to the Grand Consul.
relations.quote: We pay you to see flaws.

relations.note: Tezzeret is Special Grand Consul.
relations.quote: now Special Grand Consul Tezzeret, endowed by the Consuls for the duration of the present crisis

relations.note: calls him master
relations.quote: No, master, I did not doubt.

relations.note: Bolas sent Tezzeret on missions.
relations.quote: Bolas sent Tezzeret to Kaladesh to retrieve a portal that can transport objects.

relations.note: prototyped it as a weapon
relations.quote: She told me about Tezzeret and the weapon he was prototyping.

relations.note: Tezzeret retaliated when they refused to sell their land and burned the village
relations.quote: But when the nezumi refused to sell their land, Tezzeret retaliated.

relations.note: work together on the laboratory research
relations.quote: Jin-Gitaxias appeared from the shadows, moving beside Tezzeret like a looming nightmare.

relations.note: Tezzeret restrains her in the trap
relations.quote: "I wouldn't do that. Not if you want your friend to live,"

relations.note: he says he has what Phyrexia wants
relations.quote: "I already have what Phyrexia wants."

relations.note: fought on opposite sides in the War of the Spark
relations.quote: They'd fought on opposite sides during the War of the Spark

relations.note: says Urabrask is on their side
relations.quote: The man I'm currently working for is in the process of acquiring it.

relations.note: Works for New Phyrexia under Norn, though secretly playing both sides.
relations.quote: "I was," Tezzeret said. "I am.

relations.note: The Planar Bridge is within Tezzeret and he uses it to transport Phyrexians across planes.
relations.quote: "The Planar Bridge."

relations.note: Tezzeret arranged Vivien's audience with Urabrask.
relations.quote: I'll vouch for him and for the intermediary who arranged for my audience with him.

relations.note: Tezzeret serves her for a promised reward while planning betrayal.
relations.quote: Then you will receive what has been promised to you.

relations.note: A loose partnership.
relations.quote: Ever since aligning himself with Urabrask

relations.note: Tezzeret says he hated Bolas.
relations.quote: I hated him, you know,

relations.note: Tezzeret carries Rona off and reproves her.
relations.quote: Next time, aim for the neck.

relations.note: he hates her while pretending loyalty
relations.quote: the one being he hated most in the Multiverse

relations.note: builds Tezzeret's darksteel body
relations.quote: Commence with the procedure.

relations.note: shadowy leader
relations.quote: as the shadowy leader of the Infinite Consortium

relations.note: second-in-command
relations.quote: Baltrice, his second-in-command in the Infinite Consortium

relations.note: saw him burn his village and tries to kill him
relations.quote: I saw you die once for burning my village to the ground,

relations.note: scraped out Tezzeret's mind
relations.quote: when he scraped out Tezzeret's mind in the Nezumi swamps

relations.note: fights him and escapes
relations.quote: both praetor and Planeswalker understood this

relations.note: Tezzeret sent young Jace to the Fomori vault.
relations.quote: Tezzeret sent him here to find something the great dragon Nicol Bolas was afraid of.

relations.note: Tezzeret directs Mm'menon to fetch intelligence and technical specifications
relations.quote: Mm'menon, have our contacts procure additional technical specifications of Guideline Station for me, and steal a codebook.

relations.note: Sami calls Tezzeret 'my lord' while testing the phrase for irony.
relations.quote: "Yes, my lord," Sami says, testing out the phrase for irony.

relations.note: Mm'menon advises Tezzeret.
relations.quote: "Mm'menon amuses me," Tezzeret says.

relations.note: Tezzeret meant to bring the artifact wherever it wanted to go.
relations.quote: And I made it my genuine intention to bring that thing, once it was in my possession, wherever it wanted to go.

relations.note: Mm'menon lent their services to Tezzeret.

pages_say.description: The head of the Consortium Jace once belonged to.
The leader of a criminal Consortium for which Liliana and Jace once worked.
A gray-haired man with a metallic claw for a right hand and a hidden face, who is Head Judge of the Inventors' Fair and hunts the Renegade Prime.
The Fair's Head Judge with a metal claw arm who arrests Pia, and whom Liliana knows.
A planeswalking criminal who ordered Nashi's village burned and who Tamiyo thought had died, now reportedly in power on Kaladesh with a false arm.
A planeswalker and Head Judge of the Inventors' Fair with a metallic right arm who duels Pia and uses the Fair to confiscate every invention.
A metal-mage and planeswalker with a replacement metal arm who runs the Fair, orders the confiscation of inventions, and wants a secure inquirium for his own research into Rashmi's work.
A notorious Planeswalker and head judge of the Inventors' Fair who schemes to confiscate its inventions.
A planeswalker the Gatewatch fears may accompany the Consulate; Chandra calls him a tool.
A dangerous artificer who controls and leads the Consulate and is hidden in a private workshop in the central Aether Spire.
The metal-handed Grand Consul and Rashmi's patron, a cruel tyrant who demands progress and threatens to kill inventors who fail him.
The Grand Consul who tyrannically rules Ghirapur and signed an order draining the city's aether.
The Grand Consul in the Spire whom Jace is here to stop.
The Consulate leader building the Planar Bridge, whom Liliana wants to duel.
A planeswalker artificer with an etherium arm, building the planar portal while working to pay a debt to Nicol Bolas.
The artificer who has escaped and whom the Gatewatch plan to stop.
A planeswalker who may have warned Bolas of the Gatewatch.
The metal-armed Special Grand Consul with crimson tattoos that remind him of a debt, who screams at staff and sends Baral after the Nalaars.
A planeswalker who serves Bolas and arrives late to the plaza to be sent to fetch Ral Zarek.
One of Bolas's associates who uses the Planar Bridge and whom Vraska is to call.
A planeswalker who aided Bolas; Zarek agrees to hunt him.
The name Tameshi whispers with his last breath, in answer to how he knew the man with the metal arm.
A planeswalker with a metal arm who ordered the attack on Nashi's village, tried to control Kyodai with a Reality Chip prototype, and is researching kami.
A pink-eyed planeswalker with a metal arm who controls technology, working with Phyrexia, and traps Kaito and Tamiyo.
A planeswalker with a metal arm and power over technology who works for Phyrexia, seizes the Reality Chip's hold and escapes with Tamiyo.
A planeswalker with clanking metal in a wide-brimmed hat, working for Urabrask, who meets Vivien in the Caldaia.
A planeswalker largely encased in metal who ferries Phyrexian troops and praetors with the Planar Bridge for Elesh Norn while secretly playing both sides.
A planeswalker who arranged Vivien's audience with Urabrask and still has access to the Planar Bridge; Kaya does not trust him.
A planeswalker with an etherium arm and the Planar Bridge in his chest, serving the Phyrexians for the promise of a darksteel body, who secretly turns against Elesh Norn.
A planeswalker serving the Phyrexians who spares Elspeth and carries off the wounded Rona.
An artificer planeswalker and leader of the Infinite Consortium who deceives Elesh Norn into granting him a darksteel body, then escapes and schemes in the shadows.
The leader of the Infinite Consortium who sent young Jace to the Fomori vault.
A planeswalker who has arrived in Pinnacle space from outside, working through Mm'menon to learn the system and find a way across the Chaos Wall back to the Multiverse.
A metal-bodied wizard with a human head who says he can walk between realities and sells the Endstone, intending to follow it to its maker; he paralyzes Haliya's armor with a gesture.
A wizard aboard the Seriema whom Sami expects might cast a spell against mass leeches.
A metal-bodied wizard who kills a Monoist paladin, takes the Endstone to its destination, and keeps two severed fingers of the stone's visitor.
A human with an indestructible darksteel body who was ejected from the Blind Eternities into the Edge, where his magic makes him thrive and he builds a criminal consortium.
One who, with Alhammarret, forced Jace to hurt people.
One of the monsters that forced Jace to hurt others.
A devious inventor and planeswalker who manipulates metal to create complex devices and deadly mechanical servants.
